canonical_distinctions.explanation: A correlated exact boundary relation establishes a genuine WALL specimen. Exact ORCSP/ROBDD representations on this finite two-bit boundary establish a local exact-interface pass only. They do not establish a polynomial bound for arbitrary boundary size or composition.

semantic_space.exact_relation: R_C(14,58) = { beta in {0,1}^2 | exists x12,x83 : F_C(x12,x83,beta)=1 }
semantic_space.first_genuine_wall_definition: UUF100_007/[12,83] may be named FIRST_GENUINE_WALL_SPECIMEN iff R_C is nonconstant and differs exactly from the Cartesian product of its unary projections.

constructor_firewall.internal_assignment_enumeration: exactly four assignments to the frozen two-variable cell; constant-size scoped elimination

representation_A.name: OR_OF_CANONICAL_RESIDUAL_CSP
representation_A.construction: For each of the four internal assignments to x12,x83, restrict the two local CSP constraints, project surviving tuples to boundary variables, canonicalize residual constraints, then OR the four residual-CSP branches.
representation_A.exactness_target: Equivalent to existential elimination of the frozen two-variable cell for every boundary assignment.

representation_B.name: CANONICAL_ROBDD
representation_B.build_source: Compile symbolically from OR_OF_CANONICAL_RESIDUAL_CSP; do not build from the four-point truth table.
representation_B.interpretation: Passing the envelope on this specimen is only scoped finite evidence, not a general polynomial-size theorem.

allowed_truth_table_exception.purpose: Independent semantic microscope: directly evaluate the local CSP existentially on all four boundary assignments and compare against ORCSP and ROBDD.

required_checks: sealed reduced hash matches census authority
constructor did not enumerate boundary cube
ORCSP truth values equal independent four-point semantic truth table
ROBDD truth values equal independent four-point semantic truth table
ORCSP and ROBDD are exactly equivalent
candidate source audit finds no detector/SAT/cube shortcut

overall_precedence: nonconstant but product of unary projections -> FAIL_UNARY_FACTORIZATION
correlated but scoped ROBDD envelope exceeded -> FAIL_CLOSURE_BLOWUP
correlated and ORCSP+ROBDD exact under frozen accounting -> PASS_LOCAL_EXACT_INTERFACE_NONTRIVIAL_CORRELATED

post_pass_policy.if_local_interface_pass: Freeze result, then perform separate preregistered A/B against an old quotient-style exact baseline Q_old if such a baseline can be defined without changing the specimen semantics.
